git diff --check && git diff --stat && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('docs/README.md'), Path('docs/runbooks/README.md'), Path('docs/runbooks/receipts-stopped.md')]
for path in paths:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        assert (path.parent / target).exists(), (path, target)
print('All links in changed documentation resolve.')
PY
